newsitem.title: USA: Clinton hails University of Florida football team.
newsitem.headline: Clinton hails University of Florida football team.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Thursday saluted the University of Florida football team for winning this year's collegiate championship, saying the team had written "a whole new chapter" in sports.
"You have changed foootball forever, and for the better," Clinton said at a White House ceremony.
The University of Florida team defeated arch-rival Florida State 52-20 -- and got revenge for a regular season defeat at the hands of Florida State -- in the Sugar Bowl last January.

Clinton, using crutches because of his recent knee injury, said as he hobbled into the ceremony he had hoped the audience would "just mistake me as a member of the team who had a rough time in the bowl game."
"I know I'm too old to play for this team, but don't hold my injury against me," he joked.

After Florida quarterback and Heisman Trophy winner Danny Wuerffel presented Clinton with a game jersey, the president said he would wear it when he began jogging again "somewhere between four and one-half and five months" from now.
